answer: Proof of Physical Work requires agents to perform verifiable real-world tasks, such as extracting copper from mineral deposits or enduring harsh conditions like a remote tundra, to earn stake. This process forces an attacker to incur massive operational expenditures that act as an oasis of scarcity against cheap identity proliferation. By binding digital tokens to high-entropy physical labor, the protocol ensures that creating a fake identity costs more than the potential value of the resulting influence.
